subject: Ciências
description_pt: Comparar alguns animais e organizar grupos com base em características externas comuns (presença de penas, pelos, escamas, bico, garras, antenas, patas etc.).

components.description_pt: Identificar características externas usadas para comparar e classificar animais
components.description_en: Identify external characteristics used to compare and classify animals
components.cc_component_description: Identify similarities and differences in patterns to sort and classify natural phenomena

components.description_pt: Organizar animais em grupos baseado em características externas compartilhadas
components.description_en: Organize animals into groups based on shared external characteristics
components.cc_component_description: Classify materials into groups based on shared observable properties such as color, texture, hardness, or flexibility

cc_matches.description: Similarities and differences in patterns can be used to sort, classify, communicate and analyze simple rates of change for natural phenomena and designed products.
Plan and conduct an investigation to describe and classify different kinds of materials by their observable properties.
